svg.title: Three losses of the readout p 7→ap are explicit. (i) The number ap forgets which letters produced it; the letter set is kept beside it, and by Proposition 13.3 the regrouping is a bijection with multiplicity one, so no term of the old expansion is counted twice or dropped. (ii) The marginal extension integrates out every Gaussian coordinate outside I(H); by Proposition 13.5 this loses nothing for functions of the ground, and nothing else is ever evaluated on it. (iii) Outside the interior chart domain the logarithmic reader is the cutofflogarithm and does not determine the group reader; the discrepancy ∆= exp(Readlog)(replica V ) Read−1 grp is the recorded group-valued residual there. Indeed, writing B = replica V , U = Readgrp and l= Readlog, the protected interior identity is exp l= UB−1, so the ordered product gives
